class.name: GameCenterMultiplayerPeer
class.brief_description: Godot's high-level multiplayer over a Game Center match.
class.description: A [MultiplayerPeer] over a Game Center real-time match, found by matchmaking ([method find_match]), invites ([method invite], [method accept_invite]) or a party code ([method find_party_match]). Every player is connected to every other through Apple's servers. Peer IDs come from the players' gamePlayerIDs, so every device works out the same ones; the host, chosen with [method set_host], is peer [code]1[/code]. [method send_message] carries text alongside the game's packets, for coordinating the match. Purr's [Lobbies] use it on Apple platforms when the game doesn't use the online services, so most games never need it directly.

method.name: accept_invite
method.description: Takes the match from the invite the player last accepted ([signal GameCenter.match_invite_accepted]). [signal match_started] or [signal match_failed] follows.

method.name: find_match
method.description: Asks Game Center for [param min_players] to [param max_players] players (this one included) who asked for the same [param player_group], or anyone with [code]0[/code]. [signal match_started] fires once they're found, or [signal match_failed].

method.name: find_party_match
method.description: Starts the game activity [param activity_id] (set up in App Store Connect, with party codes) with [param party_code], and finds a match with the other players who started it with the same code. Needs iOS, macOS, tvOS or visionOS 26 or later: returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] before.

method.name: get_host
method.description: Returns the host's gamePlayerID, or empty until [method set_host].

method.name: get_local_player_id
method.description: Returns this player's gamePlayerID, or empty when they aren't signed in to Game Center.

method.name: get_peer_id_for_player
method.description: Returns the peer ID of the player with this gamePlayerID: [code]1[/code] for the host, otherwise one worked out from the ID, the same on every device.

method.name: get_player_for_peer_id
method.description: Returns the gamePlayerID of the player with this peer ID, or empty.

method.name: get_player_ids
method.description: Returns the gamePlayerIDs of the other players connected to the match.

method.name: invite
method.description: Opens Apple's invite screen, for up to [param max_players] players. Without a match, accepting starts one ([signal match_started]); with one, the invited players join it.

method.name: invite_player
method.description: Invites one friend (an [code]id[/code] from [method GameCenter.load_friends]) without the invite screen: to this match, or to a new one.

method.name: send_message
method.description: Sends [param message] to every other player in the match, reliably, alongside the game's packets. [signal message_received] fires on their side.

method.name: set_host
method.description: Makes the player with this gamePlayerID the host, peer [code]1[/code]. Every peer ID may change, so the game hears about every player again: set the peer on the [MultiplayerAPI] again afterwards.

signal.name: match_failed
signal.description: Emitted when no match came of [method find_match], [method find_party_match], [method invite_player] or [method accept_invite]. [param error] is [code]"cancelled"[/code], [code]"not_signed_in"[/code] or [code]"failed"[/code], and [param message] is Game Center's own.

signal.name: match_started
signal.description: Emitted when there's a match to play in (also when the invite screen added players to it).

signal.name: message_received
signal.description: Emitted when another player sent a message with [method send_message].

signal.name: player_connected
signal.description: Emitted when another player connected to the match after it started.

signal.name: player_disconnected
signal.description: Emitted when another player left the match.
